description: This file defines the SkillsSettings view and related components for managing and displaying skills, their status, installation options, and environment configurations within an app's settings interface.

classes.name: SkillsSettingsModel
classes.description: An observable class managing the state and operations related to skills, including refresh, install, enable/disable, and environment update actions.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Fetches the current status of skills from the backend and updates the skills list.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Initiates the installation of a skill on a specified target.

methods.name: setEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables a specific skill.

methods.name: updateEnv
methods.description: Updates the environment variable or API key for a specific skill.

methods.name: withBusy
methods.description: Runs a task while marking the skill as busy to prevent concurrent operations.
